title: Improving VR with NVIDIA’s Foveated Rendering
summary: A one-minute NVIDIA research demo of foveated rendering for VR using SMI eye tracking. It renders at full detail only where the eye is looking, matching the physiology of human vision.
why: Used as a visual example of how foveated rendering can cut the GPU power needed for VR.

quote.text: This is what contrast-preserving foveated rendering looks like in VR
